S50.interpretation: The repaired cross-chain ambiguity guard is a measured no-op on the complete current production supplement build; this does not imply the pre-repair shortcut is safe for arbitrary chain files.

old_executor_known_contract_violations: global instead of promoter-specific distal exclusion
side not drawn prospectively; both sides pooled and weighted by available windows
anchor_frequency used exact-start multiplicity rather than distinct overlapping promoter keys
candidate universe was a sparse deterministic proposal grid rather than the exact admissible integer-start set
superseded_15646.interpretation: The old 15,646 and new 13,510 are outputs of different control universes and selection semantics. The fact that 13,510 + 2,271 = 15,781 is not evidence that the old executor used CONTROL_B rescue.

singleton_admissible_set_caveat.interpretation: A singleton exact admissible set yields a valid structurally matched control but not a randomized control. If A and B draw the same singleton side, the control-vs-control null is structurally forced.
required_before_phase_B: freeze an explicit control-randomness stratum per retained edge using admissible-set cardinality and side
do not count structurally forced A/B equality as evidence of null calibration
report randomized-null results separately from forced/small-support strata
do not drop or reweight these edges after opening matrix values unless the rule is frozen prospectively now
